beats.en: Two children have one paratha and want to share it fairly. If one gets a big piece and the other a small piece, it is not fair. They fold it into two pieces that match exactly, and each gets one half.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 3 maths · Fair Share · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: A whole thing can be shared equally between two people. Each share is called a half, and two halves make one whole. For a share to be a half, the two parts must be exactly equal.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: A whole thing can be shared equally between two people. Each share is called a half, and two halves make one whole. For a share to be a half, the two parts must be exactly equal. If one part is bigger, it is not a half.
beats.speakEn: A whole thing can be shared equally between two people. Each share is called a half, and two halves make one whole. For a share to be a half, the two parts must be exactly equal. If one part is bigger, it is not a half.

beats.en: Amit shared a mango tree, a lamp and a blanket with his brother by taking the fruit, the night and the winter for himself. That was not fair even though it sounded equal.
beats.speakEn: Amit shared a mango tree, a lamp and a blanket with his brother by taking the fruit, the night and the winter for himself. That was not fair even though it sounded equal.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 3 maths · Fair Share · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: Half and double are partners. 3 is half of 6, and 6 is double of 3. 4 marbles are half of 8 marbles, and 8 marbles are double of 4 marbles. To find half of a number we share it equally into two.

beats.en: Half and double are partners. 3 is half of 6, and 6 is double of 3. 4 marbles are half of 8 marbles, and 8 marbles are double of 4 marbles. To find half of a number we share it equally into two.
beats.speakEn: Half and double are partners. 3 is half of 6, and 6 is double of 3. 4 marbles are half of 8 marbles, and 8 marbles are double of 4 marbles. To find half of a number we share it equally into two.

beats.en: When a whole is shared equally among four people, each share is called a quarter. Four quarters make one whole.
beats.speakEn: When a whole is shared equally among four people, each share is called a quarter. Four quarters make one whole.

type: Half and double are partners. 3 is half of 6, and 6 is double of 3.
When a whole is shared equally among four people, each share is called a quarter.
